lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，雪地碎裂有声。
lines.en: Shuffles, crunching snow loudly.

lines.zh: 粗厚的皮肤下是冰冷的肉。
lines.en: Cold flesh beneath thick skin.
Bite through bone sounds.

lines.zh: 冰冷的手指摸索着前行。
lines.en: Cold fingers feel their way forward.
Sibilant throat noises.
Eats腐烂的肉 from the snow.
Cold breath forms white mist.
Scans the distance for prey.
Slowly approaches the prey.
Icy teeth glint in the light.
Snow to my knees, and I keep walking.
My stiff knees creak with each step.
Stands still in the snow.
Empty gaze fixed forward.
Frozen fingers feel around.
Mechanically repeats actions.
Breathes slowly, waiting for an opportunity.
Gaze follows the faint light.
Cold skin reflects faint light.
Moves slowly in the snow.
Mechanically walks in the cold.
Stare blankly around.
Suddenly turns to face the player.
Cold gaze locks on the player.
Slowly approaches the player's figure.
Ice crusts hang on my fangs.
Mechanically raises a rotted hand.
Sibilant noise shows teeth.
Cold eyes stare at the player.
Seeks an opportunity to get closer to the player.
Steadily stares at the player in the snow.
Mechanically turns to track the player.

lines.zh: 冰雪中颤抖着的我，更显狼狈！
lines.en: Shivering in the snow, I look worse.

lines.zh: 这寒风刺骨，连骨头都疼！
lines.en: The cold is biting, even my bones ache.

lines.zh: 寒冷中挣扎，我难以站稳！
lines.en: Struggling in the cold, I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 寒冰中的我，越发显得衰弱！
lines.en: I am weaker in the icy cold.

lines.zh: 雪地里的挣扎，让我更加衰败！
lines.en: My struggle in the snow makes me weaker.

lines.zh: 寒冷的风雪中，我越发虚弱！
lines.en: The cold, snowy wind makes me weak.

lines.zh: 寒风中的我，显得更加枯萎！
lines.en: I look even more withered in the cold.

lines.zh: 在严寒中，我越发显得苍老！
lines.en: I look more ancient in the cold.

lines.zh: 冰雪中的挣扎，让我更加衰败！
lines.en: My struggle in the snow makes me weaker.

lines.zh: 寒冷中，我越来越难以支撑！
lines.en: In the cold, I struggle to stay upright.

lines.zh: 它那苍白的皮肤仿佛冰雪下的骷髅，寒风中散发异样的光。
lines.en: Its pale skin glows like a skeleton under the frost, radiating in the cold wind.

lines.zh: 细雪覆盖下的尸鬼，饥饿的目光紧紧盯着你。
lines.en: Draugr under the fine snow, hungry eyes fixed on you.

lines.zh: 冰冷的呼吸在它鼻孔间凝结，发出呼呼声响。
lines.en: Cold breath condenses in its nostrils, making a hissing sound.

lines.zh: 尸鬼的牙齿在雪地里显得格外锋利，锋利到能切割冰层。
lines.en: Its teeth, sharp enough to cut through ice, gleam in the snow.

lines.zh: 雪地的尸鬼寻找着腐肉，渴望得到更多。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow searches for carrion, craving more.

lines.zh: 它用冻僵的手指抓住你，寒意透过皮肤。
lines.en: It grabs you with frozen fingers, the cold seeping through your skin.

lines.zh: 在雪地的尸鬼，只有同类的温暖能驱散它的寒意。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow, only the warmth of a mate can dispel its chill.

lines.zh: 尸鬼的腐烂声音中透露出一丝渴望，它想要交配。
lines.en: Its rotting voice hints at desire, wanting to mate.

lines.zh: 雪地下的尸鬼，渴望结束孤独，找到伴侣。
lines.en: Draugr under the snow, longing to end its loneliness, find a mate.

lines.zh: 它那冰冷的身体贴着你，寒风透过衣服。
lines.en: Its cold body presses against you, the wind seeping through your clothes.

lines.zh: 尸鬼突然出现，冰冷的身体在雪地里划出一道痕迹。
lines.en: Draugr suddenly appears, its cold body leaving a mark in the snow.

lines.zh: 它那僵硬的手臂在雪中碰撞，发出嘎吱声。
lines.en: Its stiff arms collide in the snow, making a creaking sound.

lines.zh: 尸鬼在雪地里移动，仿佛冰块相互碰撞的声音。
lines.en: Draugr moves in the snow, like ice blocks clashing.

lines.zh: 雪地中的尸鬼在黑暗中徘徊，偶尔发出碰撞声。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow roams in the dark, occasionally making a collision sound.

lines.zh: 它的骨骼在碰撞中发出的嘎吱声回荡在雪地中。
lines.en: Its bones creak in the collision, echoing in the snow.

lines.zh: 尸鬼在雪地中穿行，碰撞声如同冰层破裂。
lines.en: Draugr moves through the snow, the collisions like ice cracking.

lines.zh: 它那沉重的脚步在雪地上碰撞，发出咯吱声。
lines.en: Its heavy footsteps collide in the snow, making a creaking sound.

lines.zh: 尸鬼在雪地的碰撞声中寻找着腐肉的踪迹。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow's collision sounds, searching for carrion's scent.

lines.zh: 尸鬼与僵尸在雪地的碰撞中相互撕咬。
lines.en: Draugr and zombies collide in the snow, biting each other.

lines.zh: 雪地中的尸鬼被同伴碰撞发出的声响惊吓。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow is startled by the collision sounds of a companion.

lines.zh: 它那苍白的皮肤在月光下闪耀，寻找伴侣。
lines.en: Its pale skin glows under the moonlight, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 尸鬼的低吼声在雪地中回荡，渴望交配。
lines.en: Its low growl echoes in the snow, craving to mate.

lines.zh: 在雪地中的尸鬼，渴望与同类相拥。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow, longing to be embraced by a同类.

lines.zh: 它的寒气在雪地里凝结，寻找温暖。
lines.en: Its coldness condenses in the snow, seeking warmth.

lines.zh: 尸鬼在雪地里徘徊，寻找交配的对象。
lines.en: Draugr roams in the snow, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它那腐烂的声音中透露出对交配的渴望。
lines.en: Its rotting voice hints at desire to mate.

lines.zh: 雪地中的尸鬼，渴望与同类的温暖相拥。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow, longing for the warmth of a同类.

lines.zh: 它的寒冷在雪地中显得格外明显，渴望同伴的体温。
lines.en: Its coldness stands out in the snow, craving a companion's warmth.

lines.zh: 在雪地中的尸鬼，寻找与同类相依的时刻。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow, searching for moments with a同类.

lines.zh: 尸鬼在雪地中寻找交配的对象，寒冷中渴望温暖。
lines.en: Draugr in the snow, seeking a mate, craving warmth in the cold.
Ice clings to my bones!
Fragments of the snow!
Where battles once raged!
Rot in the cold wind!
Curse of the frost!
Beneath the snow, I am!
Ice sharpens my claws!
Snow is soft, but not to me!
Cold strengthens me!
Snow, my home!

lines.zh: 冻土把我推醒，去找活人。
lines.en: The frozen ground wakes me to seek the living.
A thread of warmth crosses the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我的靴子踏碎冰面，朝你去。
lines.en: My boots crack the ice as I come for you.

lines.zh: 雪壳下，我的手指动了动。
lines.en: Beneath the frost, my fingers twitch.
Feel the chill of death!
You are mine!
Prey in my sights!

lines.zh: 细雪里走出的死人，比雪更冷。
lines.en: A dead man out of powder snow, colder than it.
Snow fills my boots and I feel nothing.
You cannot escape my curse!
One more line of footprints in the snow.
The warmth of the living never fools me.
Thirty-five health. Enough to chase far.
I turn my head that way.
I smell blood beneath the snow.
Frost your flesh!
Roar of the cold wind!

lines.zh: 寒气从我的牙缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Cold seeps out between my teeth.
Feel the sharpness of the cold!
Frost your heart!
Cold ice freezes your blood!
Ice curse consumes you!
Cold will freeze you!
I will freeze you!
Cold seeps into your marrow!
Three paces. I raise my claws.
First I grab your coat.
You back away; I follow.
The prints in the snow tell me where you went.
My jaw is frozen stiff.
This claw lands on your shoulder.
I do not pant, and I do not stop.
I close the circle slowly.

lines.zh: 你哈出的白气暴露了你
lines.en: Your white breath gives you away.
Muscle tightens under the frozen hide.

lines.zh: 冻土里伸出的手，抓住你。
lines.en: A hand out of the frozen earth takes hold of you.

lines.zh: 寒风中，我的利爪在颤抖！
lines.en: In the cold wind, my claws tremble!
Frost covers my fangs!

lines.zh: 凛冬之中，我是不死之王！
lines.en: In the winter, I am the undying king!
The cold makes me fiercer!
My roar echoes in the snow!

lines.zh: 霜雪之下，我窥伺着猎物！
lines.en: I stalk my prey under the frost!

lines.zh: 冰封之地，我的攻击最致命！
lines.en: In the frozen land, my attack is most lethal!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，寒冷将你包围！
lines.en: You cannot escape, cold surrounds you!

lines.zh: 凛冽之风中，我的攻击更加致命！
lines.en: In the bitter wind, my attacks are more deadly!
Frozen claws rake your face!
This bite comes with frost!
Your armor has gone brittle with cold!
We tumble together in the snow!
I tear your sleeve open!
I do not need to breathe. Again!
The dead do not hold back!
The mark is right at your throat!
Spawn from the frost!
Snow, my new home!
I awaken in the storm!
My footsteps echo on the ice plains!
I rise at night!

lines.zh: 寒冷之地，我的灵魂永生！
lines.en: In the cold, my soul lives on!
Snowflakes fall, I rise!
Under the frost moon, I return!

lines.zh: 寒风中，我从死亡中归来！
lines.en: In the cold wind, I return from the dead!

lines.zh: 冰封之夜，我的力量觉醒！
lines.en: In the frozen night, my power awakens!
A hand pushes out of the snowdrift.
A zombie crawls out of the powder snow.
I straighten up out of the frozen earth.
Another snowfall, another one of me.
The flames burn me.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，冰雪中更显凄凉！
lines.en: Falling from height, more凄凉in snow.
Drowned in snow, colder still.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击，让我更加破碎！
lines.en: The explosion shatters me further.

lines.zh: 箭矢穿心，冰雪中更显凄惨！
lines.en: An arrow pierces me, in snow more sadly.

lines.zh: 魔法攻击，冰雪中更加虚幻！
lines.en: Magic strikes, in snow more unreal.
Starvation, ice more harsh.

lines.zh: 雷电击中，冰雪中更显孤寂！
lines.en: Lightning strikes, ice more lonely.

lines.zh: 虚空中的我，冰雪更加寒冷！
lines.en: In the void, ice colder still.
